title: 「Hardly ... when ...」倒裝句

omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 222; it is assigned system ID ss223 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: Hardly + had + subject + past participle + when + subject + past simple

formulas.formula: Hardly + had + subject + past participle + when + subject + past simple

example: Hardly had we sat down when the fire alarm went off.
exampleZh: 我們才剛坐下，火警鐘就響了。

examples.en: Hardly had we sat down when the fire alarm went off.
examples.zh: 我們才剛坐下，火警鐘就響了。
examples.highlight: Hardly had we sat down when the fire alarm went off.

meaning.zh: 這個句型表示第一件事情才剛發生，第二件事情便立即或幾乎立即發生。

rules.zh: 放在句首時，必須使用倒裝 正確： Hardly had we sat down when the fire alarm went off. 錯誤： Hardly we had sat down when the fire alarm went off. had 必須放在主語 we 前面。
rules.en: When Hardly begins the sentence, use inversion by placing had before the subject.

rules.zh: 第一件事情使用過去完成式 句式： had + past participle 例如： ● had sat ● had arrived ● had finished ● had gone ● had been opened 第一部分描述先發生的事情。
rules.en: Use the past perfect, had + past participle, for the first event.

rules.zh: 第二件事情通常使用一般過去式 Hardly had the lesson started when the lights went out. ● had started：先發生 ● went out：緊接着發生
rules.en: Use the past simple for the second event after when.

rules.zh: 與 when 配搭 正確： Hardly had I arrived when the meeting began. 錯誤： Hardly had I arrived than the meeting began. Hardly 通常與 when 配搭。
rules.en: Pair Hardly with when, not than.

rules.zh: 已包含「才剛」的意思 不要在第一部分再加入 just。 錯誤： Hardly had I just arrived when the meeting began. 正確： Hardly had I arrived when the meeting began.
rules.en: Hardly already means that the event had only just happened, so do not add just to the first clause.

rules.zh: 不要漏掉 had 錯誤： Hardly I arrived when the meeting began. 正確： Hardly had I arrived when the meeting began.
rules.en: Do not omit had from the inverted opening.

rules.zh: 兩件事情必須非常接近 這個句型不適合描述相隔很久的事件。 不自然： Hardly had Leo moved to London when he bought a house five years later. 第二件事情必須在第一件事情之後立即或很快發生。
rules.en: The two events must be very close in time; the second should happen immediately or very soon after the first.

benefits.zh: 清楚表達兩件事情相隔很短時間 這個句型讓讀者立即明白，第二件事情幾乎在第一件事情完成後便發生。
benefits.en: It clearly shows that very little time passed between the two events.

benefits.zh: 令故事更有節奏 Hardly ... when ... 能突出突然而迅速的轉變，因此特別適合用來敘述故事、意外和令人驚訝的事 情。
benefits.en: It gives stories a stronger rhythm by highlighting a sudden and rapid change.

benefits.zh: 把兩個短句連接起來 Instead of: We sat down. The fire alarm went off immediately. You can write: Hardly had we sat down when the fire alarm went off. 你可以把兩件緊接發生的事情合併成一句完整句子。
benefits.en: It combines two short events into one complete sentence and makes their immediate relationship clear.

benefits.zh: 增加句式變化 學生經常使用： ● Then ... ● After that ... ● As soon as ... ● A moment later ... Hardly ... when ... 提供另一種表達方法，避免文章不斷使用相同的句式。
benefits.en: It adds sentence variety alongside expressions such as Then, After that, As soon as and A moment later.

benefits.zh: 適合故事、作文和較正式的敘述 這個句型可以令故事更生動，也適合在作文、報告或較正式的敘述中強調事情發生得非常快。
benefits.en: It is useful in stories, essays, reports and formal narration when events happen in rapid succession.
